factor_name: Beta-neutral residual reversal scaled by volatility

calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(residual_return, 20) / rolling_std(asset_return, 20), shifted by one completed session
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, regress daily returns on the equal-weight cross-asset market return using a 60-session rolling beta, compute residual returns, and rank the negative 20-session accumulated residual return normalized by 20-session asset volatility. The one-session lag prevents look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 20-session horizon passes the benchmark gates, with conservative interpretation due to the 15-asset cross-section. The relationship was strongest in 2026-2032 and reversed in 2033-2035; use with regime-aware attenuation and revalidate frequently.
